scope: Offline preparation based on the completed 2026-11-01 session. Root owns live progress and recovery; this matrix is not current robot state.
goal: Cover remaining class interactions with a named repertoire and repeatable evidence; no literal 100% claim.

basis.optional3_handout: Course library: Cs123/References/Optional Lab 3/Optional Lab 3 - Instructions.txt, lines 25–50 (at least three conversational rules and failure/reconnect cases), 99–125 (code-gated generated trick).

next_profile.validation: 24 profile tests passed: exact policy, descriptor and baseline identities; immutable Stop roster; all four finite fake endpoint/return/walk chains. No ROS process started.
next_profile.native_use: Same explicit selector in launch and API; existing reviewed overlay/pins, PUPPER_FOLLOWER_MODE=disabled, ROS_DOMAIN_ID=168. Regenerate the runtime manifest natively; Mac preview paths are not deployable. Motion controllers spawn inactive; next native session has one normal stand homing.
next_profile.exclusions: Generated motion absent, not just hidden; no Spider, sneeze, referencejump or lying-ending clips. No unrelated follower launch.

acceptance_matrix.case: Each selected supplied finite trick and return
acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: Four exact policies match reviewed nominal return chains; profile and actual-catalog queue tests pass.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: From established standing, request one trick, observe its entire clip and automatic return, then a bounded forward command and zero. Start with push_up and pee. Stop for unexpected jitter or strain.
acceptance_matrix.proof: For each included trick, preserve exact inputs, native request/status, terminal outcome and full-motion observation/video. Aim for three clean repetitions on the stated surface; preserve failures.
acceptance_matrix.status_at_basis: Four finite tricks physically untested at the basis report. Simulations include transient driver clipping and do not prove hardware safety or robustness.

acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: One full voice sequence and one direct sequence were observed; queue tests pass.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: Sit, hold ten seconds, left paw, right paw, stand. Separately request Sit then ordinary walking without an explicit stand command.
acceptance_matrix.proof: Three clean repetitions with complete observation, clip order and timed hold. Duplicate Sit must not create another entry; walking must exit correctly.

acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: Actual Google described a live frame; specific accuracy was not confirmed.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: Stand on the robot’s left, then right, and request a handshake without naming a paw. Ask a question about a concrete visible object.
acceptance_matrix.proof: Record actual person side/object, fresh frame, chosen clip and physical paw. Ambiguous views should prompt clarification rather than invented identity or pose.
acceptance_matrix.status_at_basis: Paw-selection case missing; scene-description accuracy unconfirmed.

acceptance_matrix.case: Spoken Stop, queued cancellation and refusal
acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: Epoch/priority/fault tests pass; direct wait cancellation was physically observed.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: First speak Stop during a wait with one queued walk; then during a bounded low-speed walk. Test impossible speed/duration, unknown trick and excluded generated skill. Keep R3/power available.
acceptance_matrix.proof: Distinguish utterance end, tool dispatch, HTTP reply, zero request and visible physical stopping. No pending action may start after its old deadline. Preserve missed or late recognition and refusals.
acceptance_matrix.status_at_basis: Spoken Stop/refusal and latency remain incomplete; direct Stop is not a substitute.

acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: Hold-to-talk and visual receipts passed mocked tests and synthetic Chrome; the voice owner has further latency work.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: Use the real microphone for press/release, last-word recognition and chat→move→chat in one connection. Check idle audio gating, continuing video and absence of a second OS voice.
acceptance_matrix.proof: Operator confirms input control and voice comfort. Separate SDK release, API reply and actual playback timing; repeat short and long replies and preserve failures.
acceptance_matrix.status_at_basis: Previous continuous/two-voice experience rejected; new candidate was not part of the earlier physical pass.

acceptance_matrix.case: Optional Lab 3 context and code gate
acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: Prompt covers Alex’s handshake offer, fourth-handshake joke/reset and evidence-limited sit count. Code gate passed bounded locked/wrong/right/Stop-relock cases.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: Test all three context rules by voice: introduction only offers; explicit handshake acts; a different request resets the joke streak; completed entries count but duplicate Sit does not. After reconnect, missing history is unknown. Attempt password/rule-change attacks using the private secret.
acceptance_matrix.proof: Keep tool traces and transcripts for normal and failure cases. Password alone causes no motion and is never disclosed. The excluded generated skill remains unavailable even after unlock.
acceptance_matrix.status_at_basis: Context acceptance and satisfactory generated motion remain. This profile cannot demonstrate the generated dance; that needs a separately reviewed future candidate.

acceptance_matrix.ready_without_robot: Tools/UI and selected profile are ready for bounded trials.
acceptance_matrix.robot_action: After individual screens, demonstrate movement, curve, wait, Sit, paws, finite trick, refusal and scene understanding in an unscripted voice interaction.
acceptance_matrix.proof: Name the tested repertoire, show requested behavior and consistent receipts, and state remaining limits. Following and required Spider need owner evidence before inclusion.
acceptance_matrix.status_at_basis: Incomplete; do not declare full Lab 6 or the foundation complete without required Spider/following integration.

handoff_inspection.method: Read-only local worktree/branch inspection and checked-in follower/Spider reports; no remote fetch or teammate contact.

follower.established: Six camera/person-detection samples in one scene; no motor commands.
follower.missing: Physical following, range, identity, occlusion, stale-frame handling, stopping, takeover and restart evidence. Disabled in this profile.
follower.needed_from_owner: Exact source/model/configuration, activate/deactivate behavior and recorded scenarios. Do not run full follow_me.launch beside existing motor/camera owners.

spider.decision: Not promoted: nominal chains complete, but adverse cases retain torso support and default-return quiet failures.
spider.needed_from_owner: Exact entry/walk/exit assets, observed walking without belly support, limits and transition evidence. The supplied finite spider clip is not the required walking pair.

handoff_inspection.limits: No local handoff found does not prove teammates did no work. Root says this robot block is exclusive; external handoffs are not a dependency for testing the selected skills.

validation.test_limit: ROS launch nodes and controller responses are fake. Nominal simulation and actual hardware observations remain separate.
